reviews.title: Bons services mais App à améliorer
reviews.text:
Wealthsimple n’est pas légalement une banque, mais offre de plus en plus de services qui l’en rapproche, cela a des frais compétitifs, et personnellement j’aime beaucoup, c’est propre, rapide, le support à la clientèle est bon…

Là où il y a des lacunes, c’est au niveau de l’App. Pour commencer, elle est conçue pour iOS et tourné uniquement en “petit format” sur iPad. Ensuite, les données graphiques sur tout ce qui est placements est réduit au strict minimum et avec des représentations régulièrement erronées. Par exemple voir une courbe monter sur une action qui descend. Pour avoir plus, il faut obligatoirement se connecter à son compte sur un ordinateur, ou passer par des App tierces qui cotent en temps réel avec des options poussées.

Bref, si le côté simpliste peut correspondre au besoin de monsieur et madame tout le monde, mais pour aller chercher les personnes qui s’intéressent aux marchés boursiers sans en faire leur métier, il y a beaucoup à faire.

reviews.text: I want to like this poorly run American company with AI as its customer service base . The deals are nice . But it takes the drivers 2+ hours to bring me food from 15 minutes away . Repeated problem . You let them pick up orders over and over again so they get your food , drive 45 minutes in the other direction , then you refund me for cold food . Terrible business model .

reviews.title: Takes wayyyy to long with no compensation
reviews.text: When an order takes an additional 45 minutes to arrive, it’s incredibly frustrating. Especially when you’re given in eta of 30 minutes, but instead it takes an hour and fifteen minutes just because the person picking up the order takes on additional orders?! That should be factored into the eta from the beginning, not slapped on at the end right when you think your food is just 15 minutes away. Super annoying, especially when you’re relying on Uber Eats for food when you have issues limiting you from leaving home. Uber Eats is feeling like less and less of a reliable service these days. Edit- I just spoke with a customer service representative, who was even more unhelpful. It’s evident that Uber has no interest in customer experience or satisfaction. What an idiotic company. Aredla Poojitha was very unhelpful.

reviews.title: Scammed
reviews.text: Had an order cancelled on me and was told I called the restaurant to cancel the order when I did not!! I contacted support and was not given a refund for a 35 dollar order that I did not even cancel. The uber eats support closed the chat on me while I was still asking questions.

reviews.title: Absolutely ridiculous
reviews.text: i placed an order that was supposed to take 30 minutes. after i placed it, uber automatically rerouted the order to a pita pit in another city, without telling me, and that 30 minute delivery time turned into 2 hours. obviously if i knew it was going to take that long i wouldn’t have placed it. i contacted customer support multiple times to explain what happened, & instead of actually being helped, customer support just kept sending me the exact same scripted message response about the restaurant accepting the order and their cancellation guidelines. i understood what they were saying the first time. if i had cancelled because i simply changed my mind or didn’t want the food anymore, then fine. but somehow i ended up paying a cancellation fee for a problem i did not create. uber made the mistake, uber charged me the circumstances of the order, and somehow im the one who has to pay for it? awesome!
